items.original_question: Soluţia de racordare se stabileşte printr-o fişă de soluţie pentru:

original_options.C: locurile de consum care se racordează la reţele electrice de medie sau joasă tensiune, indiferent de puterea solicitată, dacă soluţia de racordare este unică şi/sau evidentă

items.exact_object_scope: Fișă vs studiu for consumer type, voltage, unique/obvious solution and network impact

source_context.before_editorial_paraphrase: Art.11 separates solution sheet from study based on actual connection class.
source_context.decisive_editorial_paraphrase: Art.12(c) describes medium/low voltage demand sites with an unequivocal/obvious solution.
source_context.after_editorial_paraphrase: Art.15(b),(g) routes distributors and impact-intensive cases to study; not equivalent to Art.12(c).

option_by_option_reasoning.A: Not automatically fișă for disruptive users; Art.15(g) impact analysis may call for study; specialized context, not blanket rule.
option_by_option_reasoning.B: Distributors are explicitly assigned study at Art.15(b), regardless of grid voltage.
option_by_option_reasoning.C: Direct positive match to Art.12(c): low/medium voltage, no power limit when the connection solution is single/obvious.

original_options.B: locurile de consum şi/sau de producere care se racordează la reţele electrice având tensiunea nominală de 110 kV sau mai mare;
original_options.C: utilizatorii de tip distribuitori, indiferent de tensiunea reţelei la care se racordează

items.exact_object_scope: Fișă vs studiu for consumer type, voltage, unique/obvious solution and network impact

source_context.before_editorial_paraphrase: Art.11 sets two different technical instruments: fișă and study.
source_context.decisive_editorial_paraphrase: Art.12(a) specifically names individual household users with no fixed power cap.
source_context.after_editorial_paraphrase: Art.15(a),(b) lists high-voltage and distributors in study class, not fișă.

option_by_option_reasoning.A: Direct match at Art.12(a): individual household consumption locations regardless of power.
option_by_option_reasoning.B: >=110 kV is study, Art.15(a), not a fișă class.
option_by_option_reasoning.C: Distributors assigned study regardless of voltage, Art.15(b).

items.original_question: Soluţia de racordare se stabileşte printr-un studiu de soluţie pentru:

original_options.B: utilizatorii de tip distribuitori, indiferent de tensiunea reţelei la care se racordează
original_options.C: utilizatorii cu o putere de peste 25 kVA

items.exact_object_scope: Fișă vs studiu for consumer type, voltage, unique/obvious solution and network impact

source_context.before_editorial_paraphrase: Art.12 lists fișă categories, including domestic sites and certain under30kVA cases.
source_context.decisive_editorial_paraphrase: Art.15(b) identifies distributor-type users as study class for every voltage.
source_context.after_editorial_paraphrase: Art.15(c) requires multiple conditions for other consumer cases, not simply exceeding 25kVA.

option_by_option_reasoning.A: Individual household sites use fișă even for higher power under Art.12(a), not blanket study.
option_by_option_reasoning.B: Explicitly Art.15(b): distributors irrespective of the grid voltage.
option_by_option_reasoning.C: Arbitrary 25 kVA threshold is not blanket study trigger; Art.12(b) under30 kVA consumption sites fișă and other conditions apply.

original_options.B: Să proiecteze instalaţii electrice în cazul în care nu deţine o autorizaţie de tip A

items.exact_object_scope: Electrician personal license vs operator network proprietary installations and contractual exceptions

source_context.before_editorial_paraphrase: Art.8 distinguishes A authorization for design and B for execution for II-IV.
source_context.decisive_editorial_paraphrase: Art.37(b) restricts designing and executing to a valid type/grade authorization.
source_context.after_editorial_paraphrase: Art.37(d) demands a project by qualified designer, not self-authorship by the executor.

option_by_option_reasoning.A: Type A permits design within its grade and conditions; 'only A' is not itself a ban on design.
option_by_option_reasoning.B: Design without design authorization type A violates authorization competencies (Art.8(2), Art.37(b)).
option_by_option_reasoning.C: Executing from another authorized professional's project is compatible with Art.37(d), conditional on the executing person's own valid type B and scope.

original_options.A: Să proiecteze instalaţii electrice în cazul în care deţine doar autorizaţie de tip A
original_options.B: să execute lucrări, manevre sau intervenţii sub orice formă în instalaţiile operatorilor de reţea
original_options.C: Să realizeze lucrări de instalaţii electrice în baza unor documentaţii de proiectare realizate de alţi electricieni autorizaţi

items.exact_object_scope: Electrician personal license vs operator network proprietary installations and contractual exceptions

source_context.before_editorial_paraphrase: Art.37(c),(d) authorizes work after legal approvals and a suitable design.
source_context.decisive_editorial_paraphrase: Art.37(j) qualifies intervention in operator network assets by existence of contracts with the network operator.
source_context.after_editorial_paraphrase: Possession of authorization alone does not supply contractual rights for network components, but contract cases can change the ban.

option_by_option_reasoning.A: Design using valid type A is not forbidden, within grade and scope.
option_by_option_reasoning.B: Art.37(j) disallows work/operations in network operator installations WITHOUT necessary agreements/contracts. Original answer omits 'fără contracte'; unconditional prohibition is not established.
option_by_option_reasoning.C: Execution based on projects authored by other licensed designers is allowed for a properly licensed executor; no blanket ban.

original_options.A: Să semneze documentaţii de orice fel pentru proiecte sau lucrări pe care nu le-a realizat sau supravegheat
original_options.B: Să proiecteze instalaţii electrice în cazul în care deţine doar autorizaţie de tip A
original_options.C: Să realizeze lucrări de instalaţii electrice în baza unor documentaţii de proiectare realizate de alţi electricieni autorizaţi

items.exact_object_scope: Electrician personal license vs operator network proprietary installations and contractual exceptions

source_context.before_editorial_paraphrase: Art.37(d),(e) specifies documented and compliant execution duties.
source_context.decisive_editorial_paraphrase: Art.37(f) prohibits signing documents for work without own design, execution or direct supervision.
source_context.after_editorial_paraphrase: The option refers to 'proiecte sau lucrări' and uses 'realizat'; verify exact equivalence with 'proiectează/execută' before grading.

option_by_option_reasoning.A: Art.37(f) bars signing work docs not designed, executed or directly supervised by signer; original 'nu le-a realizat sau supravegheat' must be mapped to those actions and exception.
option_by_option_reasoning.B: Type A design is permitted within grade; no general ban.
option_by_option_reasoning.C: Projects by a different qualified designer can be used in execution, provided correct B authorization; not a ban.

items.original_question: Conform normativului I-7-2011, protecţia de bază  reprezintă:

original_options.A: protecţia împotriva şocurilor electrice în absenţa defectului
original_options.B: protecţia care corespunde protecţiei împotriva atingerilor indirecte.
original_options.C: protecţia împotriva şocurilor electrice în caz de defect

items.exact_object_scope: Definition distinction between protection without defect and under a single fault
items.source_article: I7 Definitions: protecție de bază; protecție în caz de defect

source_context.before_editorial_paraphrase: Glossary distinguishes protective categories by presence or absence of a fault.
source_context.decisive_editorial_paraphrase: Basic protection safeguards against electric shock in the normal/no-fault condition.
source_context.after_editorial_paraphrase: Fault protection is defined for single-fault situations and maps to indirect-contact safety.

option_by_option_reasoning.A: Exact base-protection defining condition: against electric shock in absence of a fault.
option_by_option_reasoning.B: Indirect contact corresponds to protection in case of fault, not basic protection.
option_by_option_reasoning.C: Shock during a defect corresponds to fault protection, not basic.

items.original_question: Conform normativului I-7-2011, protecţia de bază  reprezintă:

original_options.A: protecţia care corespunde protecţiei împotriva atingerilor indirecte.
original_options.B: protecţia care corespunde protecţiei împotriva atingerilor directe.
original_options.C: protecţia împotriva şocurilor electrice în caz de defect

items.exact_object_scope: Definition distinction between protection without defect and under a single fault
items.source_article: I7 Definitions: protecție de bază; atingere directă

source_context.before_editorial_paraphrase: Basic protection concerns normal, non-fault conditions.
source_context.decisive_editorial_paraphrase: Definition equates basic protection to protection against direct contact.
source_context.after_editorial_paraphrase: Fault protection separately covers the simple-fault regime and indirect contact.

option_by_option_reasoning.A: Indirect-contact protection belongs to fault protection.
option_by_option_reasoning.B: Definition directly equates basic protection with direct-contact protection.
option_by_option_reasoning.C: Protection in a fault condition is a different class.

items.original_question: Conform normativului I-7-2011, protecţia în caz de defect  reprezintă:

original_options.A: o protecţie împotriva şocurilor electrice în condiţii de defect simplu.
original_options.B: o protecţie împotriva şocurilor electrice în condiţii de scurtcircuit
original_options.C: protecţia care corespunde protecţiei împotriva atingerilor directe.

items.exact_object_scope: Definition distinction between protection without defect and under a single fault
items.source_article: I7 Definitions: protecție în caz de defect; defect simplu

source_context.before_editorial_paraphrase: The glossary identifies basic protection for absence of faults.
source_context.decisive_editorial_paraphrase: Protection in case of fault is defined for a single-fault condition.
source_context.after_editorial_paraphrase: The same definition associates it with protection against indirect contact.

option_by_option_reasoning.A: Exact defining case is electrical shock protection in a single fault condition.
option_by_option_reasoning.B: Short circuit is one possible fault form but is not the complete definition of protection under any single fault.
option_by_option_reasoning.C: Direct contact refers to basic protection, not fault protection.
